floor3Companion._killXpBase_note: Flat combat-XP pool awarded to a Companion team per enemy Companion KO'd (spec R7 / slice 5). Placeholder magnitude — no Floor 3 scenario spawns Companions yet, so this is not balance-swept; downstream slice 16 tunes it via a win-rate sweep.
floor3Companion._assistFloorShare_note: Fraction of killXpBase split evenly across every living (non-knocked-out) Companion on the credited team, regardless of whether they landed a hit. The remainder splits damage-weighted across contributors only.
floor3Companion._engagementRangeFt_note: Distance (ft) within which a rival-team Companion counts as keeping a team 'engaged' for KO recovery purposes (spec R5/R11, slice 6). Placeholder magnitude, not yet balance-swept.
floor3Companion._engagementEndFrames_note: Frames (at 60 FPS, ~3s) a team must go without any rival within engagementRangeFt before its knocked-out Companions recover (spec R11 'short window', slice 6).
floor3Companion._wildAggroRangeFt_note: Floor-3 wild mobs become hostile only when the player is within this player-anchored range. Initial value is 3/4 of the normal horizontal screen radius: 1280px / camera zoom 2 / 8px-per-foot = 80ft visible width, 40ft radius, 30ft at 75%. Disengage is derived as 2x this value.
floor3Companion._rallyPointRangeFt_note: Proximity radius (ft) within which the player instantly revives the whole party at a Rally Point (spec §8/R11, slice 6); matches the harvest/boss-chest pickup radius convention.
floor3Companion._commandCooldownFrames_note: Frames (at 60 FPS, ~5s) a Companion's signature ability stays on cooldown after the player commands it (spec R7 / game-design §15 surface 7). Placeholder magnitude — the Floor 3 ability effects are not authored yet, so this gates only the command affordance; slice 16 tunes it with the abilities.
floor3Companion._commandLevelsPerCapacityCharge_note: Player levels required per EXTRA simultaneous command charge (spec R7 'player level also powers Floor-3 command capacity'). Capacity is 1 + floor((playerLevel - 1) / this), capped at partyMaxSize.
floor3Companion._partyMaxSize_note: Starter pick + 5 poaches = 6 (spec R5); PartySlot.locked latches once this many Companions have been recruited.
floor3Companion._starterLevel_note: Floor-3-ONLY initial level for the player's starter Companion (recruitFloor3PartyCompanion), replacing a hardcoded level 1. Raised to the adult-form threshold (species.ts FORM_MIN_LEVELS[2]=25) so the lone starter is not stuck at the weakest (baby, statScale 1.0) band while the party is still size-1 against multi-Companion Studio/wild encounters. Human-authorized Floor-3-only tuning lever (session 2026-09-03); does not touch Floor 1/2 leveling.
floor3Companion._playerCompanionHpMultiplier_note: Floor-3-ONLY HP multiplier applied only to the player's own recruited party Companions (TeamId.PLAYER) at recruit time, on top of the shared species/form statScale every Companion (wild, Studio, Final Four) already uses. Compensates for the party's structural numbers disadvantage (1 starter vs a multi-Companion Studio/Final-Four roster) without touching wild/rival Companion stats. Human-authorized Floor-3-only companion buff (session 2026-09-03); tune via floor3-companion-lab, not a broad win-rate sweep.
floor3Companion._playerCompanionDamageMultiplier_note: Floor-3-ONLY outgoing-damage multiplier applied only to the player's own recruited party Companions (TeamId.PLAYER) in companionCombatSystem, leaving wild/Studio/Final-Four Companion damage (and all other floors) untouched. Same rationale/authorization as playerCompanionHpMultiplier: offsets being outnumbered, not a general balance claim.

factionRelations._friendlyLeashTiles_note: Friendly-band ally mobs stop closing on the player once inside this radius (tiles). Beyond it they steer toward the player to close ranks. Slice 3 / FR11.
factionRelations._friendlyRetaliationMs_note: How long (world.elapsedMs) a friendly-band mob prioritises the player's most recent attacker before reverting to follow. Slice 3 / FR11.
factionRelations._feudEngagementRadiusTiles_note: Radius (tiles) used when a family-driven mob searches for a rival-family target. Bounds the spatial-hash candidate lookup so feud targeting stays inside the Floor-1 engagement budget (ADR 0024). Slice 3 / FR12.
factionRelations._feudCandidateLimit_note: Hard cap on the number of candidate rivals inspected per mob per frame. Prevents O(n^2) rival scanning at Floor-2 entity counts; the spatial-hash query is trimmed to this before nearest-selection. Slice 3 / FR12.
factionRelations._eventCooldownsNote: Per-emergent-event minimum re-fire interval in ms. Only meaningful for non-one-shot events; one-shot events fire at most once per run regardless. Slice 6.

shopPricing._note: Floor 1 + Floor 2 shop pricing. Floor 1 prices are absolute gold values; Floor 2 runtime price = basePrice * archetype.priceMultiplier * floor2TierMultiplier. Quartermaster generated stock uses the same tier multiplier so all Floor 2 shop surfaces stay in the same economy curve.

floor1._note: Floor 1 gold sinks, tuned against measured Floor 1 income (~800g earned per completed run: enemy/chest drops plus achievement loot boxes). The sum of everything buyable on Floor 1 (charm + up to two post-quest weapons + up to two spells) is deliberately close to that income so a run must choose rather than buy the whole board and still bank a fortune for Floor 2. The broker rack steps DOWN from the headline spell (spellBrokerCost * spellBrokerRepeatCostMultiplier^n): a second spell is the sink for a run that declined the merchant's weapon-class switch, and at Floor 1 income a repeat priced above the headline is never reachable (measured: at 1.4x nothing buys it and the gate fails). Gate: median unspent gold at Floor 1 exit <= 35% of gold earned, at >= 90% Floor 1 win rate. merchantsCharm is pinned to the agreed band's floor (60, not 100): unlike the weapon/spell purchases, the charm is a REQUIRED shop-quest step gating the boss-stair-room door (see floor1-goal-graph.ts's `farm-shop-gold`), so its price extends every run's mandatory completion time, not just an optional detour — 100 pushed the bow-seed-35 retreat regression past the official time budget (tests/headless/floor1-retreat-objective-bias-regressions.test.ts).

attackWaves._note: Periodic rat pack waves. Disabled by default. Waves spawn off-screen at regular intervals and charge the player unless suppressed by proximity to a safe room.
